name: ai-lib
description: The shared player UI (notifications, progress bar, prompts, menus, inputs, minigames) and the @aicore-fivem/lib helpers for resources that do not bundle it: @ai-lib/init.lua (Lua) or @ai-lib/dist/client.js / server.js (JavaScript)

scripts.build: bun run --cwd web build && bun tsdown -- && aicore-client-errors dist/client.js && aicore-client-errors dist/ui.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p resource/client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p resource/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p resource/ui/tsconfig.json
